what: Planned hint documents --allow-findings-outside-tmpdir=true but the parser only accepts the split argv form
scenario_or_breakage: An operator copies the rejection hint or doc bullet and gets unknown option instead of bypassing containment
suggested_fix: Either change the hint/docs/tests to --allow-findings-outside-tmpdir true or add parser support for --allow-findings-outside-tmpdir=true and test both forms

what: Plan relaxes containment to any regular non-symlink path and explicitly skips SECURITY.md
scenario_or_breakage: With the flag enabled, a caller bug can rewrite an arbitrary same-UID regular file outside the session because success ends in mv -f to FINDINGS_FILE
suggested_fix: Bound the escape hatch to an explicit canonical allow-root such as the parent round/session dir, keep symlink checks, and update SECURITY.md with the new trust boundary and residual overwrite risk

what: Plan validates the new boolean after the containment branch that consumes it
scenario_or_breakage: For an outside findings file plus --allow-findings-outside-tmpdir maybe, the script reports a containment rejection instead of the promised must be true or false error
suggested_fix: Validate ALLOW_FINDINGS_OUTSIDE_TMPDIR before the containment case and add a regression for invalid value with an outside findings path

what: The proposed allowed-outside test says to use a 2-block ballot with the existing merge stub but does not require the input reviewer set to match the stub output
scenario_or_breakage: The merge stub emits cursor-a, cursor-b, and cursor-c; a natural 2-reviewer input makes validation fail with unknown reviewer slot before proving the allow path
suggested_fix: Specify the outside test fixture must include all three reviewer labels emitted by the stub, or add a dedicated two-reviewer merge stub variant

what: The proposed sibling mktemp directory is not covered by the existing trap
scenario_or_breakage: The new regression leaves TMP_OUTSIDE behind after successful or failed harness runs
suggested_fix: Either extend the trap to remove TMP_OUTSIDE or use a review tmpdir subdirectory under TMP so the outside findings directory can still be cleaned by the existing trap
